parts.title: Musa and the Servant of God

bridge.when: The forty years after the crossing
bridge.where: The Sinai desert and the lands around it
text: Free at last, the Children of Israel are in the desert with Musa and Harun. God feeds and shelters them, and gives Musa the Torah on the mountain.
Yet freedom is a test too. Much of this chapter is about a people learning to trust God, and failing, and being forgiven. It also tells of Musa's own journey to learn from a servant of God.
